notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W7-13-Q01_5 railway level crossing warning sign (2022, page 5 of 7): road and side road crossed obliquely by a railway. Size A 600 (B 750, C 900 also tabled): side 600 drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, yellow edge 8 + black border 16. The sheet's vectors are to scale; table A: d 250, e 100, f 250, g 224, h 16, k 120, m 88, n 424. Symbol: the sheet PDF's own vector artwork (tools/symbols/qld_w7-13-q01-5_legend.svg, items 97-98), placed as the sheet draws it: 418.0 x 496.1 with its box 246.6 left / 171.4 right of the vertical centreline and 249.3 above / 246.8 below the horizontal centreline. Black on retroreflective yellow.
